The Codex run's opened_urls is empty and every tool_result states the search payload was not exposed; its evidence_passages are just its own final_answer duplicated under five URLs, so they do not attest to what those pages say. It also restates the supported negative finding already carried by claim_no_public_event_evidence, and its grading is brittle: both acceptable_patterns require long verbatim teacher wording, and required_concepts such as 'most_defensible_conclusion' and 'why' are too vague to grade deterministically.
